parent_schedule.location_by_location_comparison: SOURCE_BLOCKED until exact bytes are recovered

schedule_phases.name: TEMPORAL_RECEIPT
schedule_phases.action: Preserve a fresh pre-boundary gauge/history receipt when the platform exposes it. Do not infer missing post-event information from a later snapshot.
schedule_phases.gate1_constraint: Sites 1-3 can partially reopen with four commuting pre-loss receipt bits; sites 4-8 remain NO-GO under the declared arbitrary post-loss survivor-Pauli model using survivor gauge algebra alone.

schedule_phases.name: SHELL_ONLY_CENTER
schedule_phases.rule: Use separate syndrome ancillas or an otherwise proved non-spreading construction. These checks do not touch T_C.

schedule_phases.name: CROSS_BOUNDARY_CENTER
schedule_phases.rule: Fresh syndrome ancilla per check; no ancilla reuse across the two checks before measurement/reset. When compatible with the native parity circuit, order shell interactions before core interactions. Add a flag or verified-cat mechanism for cross-partition hook detection.

schedule_phases.name: SYNDROME_COORDINATE_RECOVERY
schedule_phases.action: Map b back to frozen s coordinates and apply the existing ideal-center decoder only on an accepted complete record.

schedule_phases.name: FAIL_CLOSED
schedule_phases.action: Flagged, incomplete, stale, or loss-invalidated temporal receipts return HOLD/quarantine; do not guess a recovery.

conservative.name: VERIFIED_CAT_CROSS_CHECKS
conservative.principle: Measure each cross check with a verified distributed ancilla so one syndrome ancilla does not serially bridge multiple data sites.

lower_resource.name: FLAGGED_SINGLE_ANCILLA_CROSS_CHECKS
lower_resource.principle: Single syndrome ancilla plus flag, with shell-first/core-last ordering.

break_even_cost_rule.model: C = cS*N_shell + cC*N_core + cH*N_hub8 + cX*N_cross, with source-bound nonnegative costs fixed before evaluation
break_even_cost_rule.candidate_minus_current: Delta C = cS - cC - cH - cX
break_even_cost_rule.meaning: The basis shift removes one core/hub/cross incidence but adds one shell incidence. It is not universally better; physical/noisy-circuit costs decide.

frozen_evaluation_protocol.acceptance: Every declared single fault must end as protected logical I after recovery OR a declared detected HOLD/quarantine. Any unflagged protected-logical nonidentity is FAIL.
frozen_evaluation_protocol.comparison: Parent v0.2 and candidate must use identical gate/noise assumptions, timing, decoder policy and discard accounting.
frozen_evaluation_protocol.tuning: No schedule/order/threshold changes after evaluation exposure without versioning and fresh confirmatory replay.
